title: RBI repo-rate dataset — annual
description: Schema for the annual configuration of the independent RBI repo-rate dataset.

year.description: Calendar year, including years with no canonical ledger records.

start_policy_rate_pct.description: Rate in force immediately before January 1 of the year.
start_policy_rate_pct.x-null-semantics: Null when no earlier canonical rate is available.

end_policy_rate_pct.description: Rate in force on December 31 of the year.
end_policy_rate_pct.x-null-semantics: Null when no canonical rate is in force by year end.

min_policy_rate_pct.description: Minimum known in-force rate during the year, including a carry-in rate.
min_policy_rate_pct.x-null-semantics: Null when no canonical rate is known during the year.

max_policy_rate_pct.description: Maximum known in-force rate during the year, including a carry-in rate.
max_policy_rate_pct.x-null-semantics: Null when no canonical rate is known during the year.

net_change_bps.description: End rate minus start rate in basis points; null if either boundary is unknown.
net_change_bps.x-null-semantics: Null when start_policy_rate_pct or end_policy_rate_pct is null.

gross_hikes_bps.description: Sum of positive canonical transitions within the calendar year.

gross_cuts_bps.description: Absolute sum of negative canonical transitions within the calendar year.

decision_count.description: Count of all canonical ledger rows whose effective_date falls in the year.

policy_decision_count.description: Count of policy_decision rows in the year.

historical_observation_count.description: Count of historical_rate_observation rows in the year.

hike_count.description: Count of canonical rows labeled hike in the year.

cut_count.description: Count of canonical rows labeled cut in the year.

hold_count.description: Count of canonical rows labeled hold in the year.

first_decision_date.description: Effective date of the first canonical row in the year.
first_decision_date.x-null-semantics: Null when the year has no canonical ledger rows.

last_decision_date.description: Effective date of the last canonical row in the year.
last_decision_date.x-null-semantics: Null when the year has no canonical ledger rows.

year_end_action.description: Action of the final in-year canonical row; null when the year-end rate is carried in from an earlier year.
year_end_action.x-null-semantics: Null when no canonical row in the year establishes the year-end state.

year_end_stance.description: Stance of the final in-year canonical row.
year_end_stance.x-null-semantics: Null when no in-year stance is available.

year_end_regime_id.description: Regime containing December 31 under start-inclusive/end-exclusive matching.
year_end_regime_id.x-null-semantics: Null when December 31 falls in a regime gap.

year_end_regime_type.x-null-semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

year_end_regime_label.x-null-semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

year_end_source_id.description: Primary source supporting the rate in force at year end.
year_end_source_id.x-null-semantics: Null when no year-end rate is known.

year_end_source_url.x-null-semantics: Null means the value is unavailable in the canonical snapshot.

source_count.description: Distinct sources used by in-year canonical rows and the year-end carry-in state.

provenance_summary.description: Sorted pipe-delimited provenance classes represented in the year.

snapshot_id.description: SnapshotV2 identifier used as the build input.

snapshot_checksum.description: SnapshotV2 content checksum used as the build input.

dataset_schema_version.description: Independent semantic schema version for this dataset.

record_text.description: Deterministically generated factual annual summary for search, RAG, and agent use.

x-row-grain: one row per calendar year from the earliest through latest snapshot year
